title: Zsh & Oh My Zsh Power Tips
description: Level up your terminal with Zsh features, Oh My Zsh plugins, aliases, and globbing tricks.

entries.label: Useful Aliases
entries.command:
alias ll='ls -lah'
alias gs='git status'
alias dc='docker compose'
entries.description: Add to your .zshrc — short aliases for frequently typed commands

entries.label: Global Alias (Pipe)
entries.command:
alias -g G='| grep'
alias -g L='| less'
alias -g C='| wc -l'
entries.description: Global aliases expand anywhere in a command: 'ps aux G node'

entries.label: Auto-Suggest Plugin
entries.description: Add to .zshrc plugins array — shows ghost text suggestions as you type

entries.label: Directory Stack (cd History)
entries.command:
d      # list recent dirs
cd -2  # jump to 2nd most recent dir
entries.description: Zsh tracks your directory history — jump back without typing paths

entries.label: Glob: Recursive
entries.description: List all .ts files recursively in subdirectories (Zsh globbing)

entries.label: Glob: Modified Today
entries.description: List files modified today using Zsh glob qualifiers

entries.label: Edit Last Command
entries.description: Open the last command in your $EDITOR for complex edits

entries.label: Repeat Last Argument
entries.description: !$ expands to the last argument of the previous command

entries.label: Replace in Last Command
entries.description: Re-run the last command with 'typo' replaced by 'fix'

entries.label: Named Directory
entries.description: Create a short name for a frequently accessed directory

entries.label: Keybindings — Word Jump
entries.description: Opt+Arrow to jump between words in the terminal (macOS)
